title: Source (v1)
description: A public source or import with its privacy and licensing record (ARCHITECTURE.md section 9). Real customer/patient data is prohibited.

locator.description: Exact source location: URL or citation string.

version.description: Exact edition, version, revision or publication date of the source.

name.description: SPDX id or the license name as stated by the source.

terms.description: Redistribution terms in brief, including attribution requirements.

transformations.description: Transformation and minimization steps applied to the source material. Empty when none.

naturallyOccurringPersonalData.description: True if the source material contains personal data that occurs naturally (not synthetic or reserved).
